This page highlights selected marketing projects that show my experience with campaign strategy, brand positioning, audience research, analytics, and professional presentation design.

---

## Super Soakerz Marketing Campaign

::: {.project-showcase}

### Overview

Super Soakerz was a student-led car window washing business created for a marketing course at Cal Poly Pomona. The project focused on building a service brand, promoting it on campus, and connecting with commuter students.

### My Role

I helped develop the campaign strategy, target market, brand messaging, and promotion ideas. The project helped me practice turning a simple service idea into a clear marketing campaign.

### Skills Used

Marketing strategy · Target market analysis · Brand positioning · Campaign planning · Campus promotion · Customer engagement

### Key Takeaway

This project showed me how important it is to understand the audience before creating a campaign. For commuter students, the strongest message was convenience, affordability, and quick service.

:::

---

## LA Galaxy Campaign

::: {.project-showcase}

### Overview

This project focused on creating a sports marketing campaign connected to the LA Galaxy brand. The goal was to think about fan engagement, audience connection, and campaign messaging.

### My Role

I worked on campaign ideas that focused on how to connect with fans through branding, social media, and event-style promotion.

### Skills Used

Sports marketing · Fan engagement · Campaign messaging · Social media strategy · Brand awareness

### Key Takeaway

This project helped me see how sports marketing is not only about promoting a team, but also about building emotional connection with fans.

:::

---

## Marketing Analytics Dashboard

::: {.project-showcase}

### Overview

This dashboard project shows how marketing data can be organized and explained visually. It focuses on turning numbers into clear insights that can support marketing decisions.

### My Role

I worked on organizing data, creating visuals, and explaining what the results meant in a marketing context.

### Skills Used

Marketing analytics · Data visualization · R · Quarto · ggplot2 · Excel · Insight communication

### Key Takeaway

This project helped me understand how data can support marketing strategy by showing patterns, trends, and customer-related insights.

:::
